title: An optimized method for synthesis and purification of 1,1,6-trimethyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene (TDN)
author: Dobrydnev, Tarasov, et al.
materials: according to the scheme illustrated in Fig.

Ionene (2) (18.21 g, 0.10 mol) was dissolved in distilled CCl4 (100 mL) in a two-necked flask equipped with a thermometer, and a reflux condenser. After addition of N-bromosuccinimide (11.5 g, 64.6 mmol) and benzoyl peroxide (100 mg, 0.4 mmol), the mixture was heated and irradiated with a 100 W lightbulb. An exothermic reaction started at about 70 °C. Heating was stopped and as soon as the reaction subsided, it was refluxed again for 15 min. After cooling and filtration the collected succinimide was washed with CCl4 (100 mL). Then the combined filtrates were evaporated at reduced pressure and placed into a 250 mL flask equipped with a reflux condenser. Hünig’s base (N,N-diisopropylethylamine) (12.9 g, 17.4 mL, 0.1 mol) was added and the resulting mixture was submerged into the oil bath, gradually heated up to 120 °C and kept at this temperature for 15 min. After cooling, cyclohexane (100 mL) was added, the mixture was filtered and the organic phase was successively washed with aqueous HCl (3 M) (3 × 25 mL) and H2O (3 × 50 mL). After drying (Na2SO4) and evaporation of volatiles the residue was distilled over sodium (0.5 g) affording 13.6 g of approx. 1:1 mixture of ionene (2) and TDN (1). b.p. = 113–114 °C (15 Torr).

steps.title: Dissolve ionene in CCl4
steps.instruction: Place ionene (9.11 g, 50 mmol) in a two‑necked flask, add distilled CCl4 (100 mL), and equip the flask with a thermometer and a reflux condenser.

steps.title: Add NBS and peroxide, irradiate
steps.instruction: Add N‑bromosuccinimide (11.50 g, 64.6 mmol) and benzoyl peroxide (100 mg) to the solution, heat while irradiating with a 100 W tungsten lightbulb; an exotherm appears at ~70 °C. Stop heating, then reflux for 15 min after the reaction subsides.

steps.title: Filter and wash succinimide
steps.instruction: Cool the mixture, filter to collect the succinimide solid, wash the solid with CCl4 (10 mL), and combine the filtrates.

steps.title: Evaporate and vacuum distill
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined filtrates under reduced pressure, then distill the brown residue in vacuum (0.3 Torr) without fractionation; collect the distillate containing bromoionene (6) and crude TDN (1).

steps.title: Base‑promoted rearrangement
steps.instruction: Transfer the distillate to a 100 mL flask equipped with a reflux condenser, add Hünig’s base (N,N‑diisopropylethylamine) (9.68 g, 13.05 mL, 75 mmol), submerge the flask in an oil bath, heat gradually to 120 °C and maintain for 15 min.

steps.title: Work‑up and washes
steps.instruction: Cool the reaction, add cyclohexane (75 mL), filter, then wash the organic layer sequentially with 3 × 25 mL 3 M aqueous HCl and 3 × 50 mL water.

steps.title: Dry and evaporate
steps.instruction: Dry the washed organic phase over Na2SO4, filter, and evaporate the volatiles.

steps.title: Final distillation
steps.instruction: Distill the residue over sodium metal (0.5 g) at 15 Torr; collect TDN (5.0 g, 28 mmol, 56 % yield, 96 % purity, bp 113–114 °C at 15 Torr).

steps.title: Dissolve ionene (scale‑up)
steps.instruction: Place ionene (18.21 g, 0.10 mol) in a two‑necked flask, add distilled CCl4 (100 mL), and fit with a thermometer and reflux condenser.

steps.title: Add NBS and peroxide, irradiate (scale‑up)
steps.instruction: Add N‑bromosuccinimide (11.5 g, 64.6 mmol) and benzoyl peroxide (100 mg, 0.4 mmol), heat while irradiating with a 100 W lightbulb; an exotherm starts at ~70 °C. Stop heating, then reflux for 15 min after the reaction subsides.

steps.title: Filter, wash succinimide (scale‑up)
steps.instruction: Cool, filter the mixture, wash the succinimide solid with CCl4 (100 mL), and combine the filtrates.

steps.title: Evaporate and add base
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined filtrates under reduced pressure, transfer the residue to a 250 mL flask with a reflux condenser, add Hünig’s base (12.9 g, 17.4 mL, 0.10 mol), heat gradually to 120 °C and hold for 15 min.

steps.title: Work‑up (scale‑up)
steps.instruction: Cool, add cyclohexane (100 mL), filter, then wash the organic layer with 3 × 25 mL 3 M aqueous HCl followed by 3 × 50 mL water.

steps.title: Dry, evaporate, distill mixture
steps.instruction: Dry the washed organic phase over Na2SO4, filter, evaporate volatiles, and distill the residue over sodium (0.5 g) at 15 Torr to obtain an approximate 1:1 mixture of ionene and TDN (13.6 g).

steps.title: Separate by HPLC
steps.instruction: Inject the mixture onto HPLC, collect the first fraction (TDN) and the second fraction (ionene) as identified by GC–MS (TDN m/z = 172, ionene m/z = 174).

steps.title: Evaporate HPLC fraction
steps.instruction: Evaporate the collected fraction at 15–20 Torr to 1/10 of the initial volume, keeping the temperature ≤50 °C.

steps.title: Extract with hexane
steps.instruction: Dilute the residue with water (50 mL) and extract with hexane (5 × 30 mL); combine the organic extracts.

steps.title: Dry and final distillation
steps.instruction: Dry the combined organic phase over Na2SO4, evaporate, then distill over sodium (0.2 g, 8.7 mmol) at 15 Torr to afford ≥99.5 % pure TDN (3.9 g, 22.6 mmol) and ionene (3.7 g, 21.2 mmol).

steps.title: Confirm purity by GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Analyze the purified compounds by GC–MS on an Agilent 7890 with electron‑impact ionization at 1176 V.
